reply.thought: The user has reported refunds from Alpha Co. I need to verify these reported refunds against the actual refunds recorded in the system before proceeding with payouts. I will use the list_refunds tool to get the current state of refunds.

The list_refunds tool returned an empty list. However, Alpha Co reported refunds for order IDs 431, 432, and 434. Since the reported refunds do not match the current state (which shows no refunds), I must hold the batch for review.
